image_description: A stocky, brown, furry marsupial (wombat) is positioned in the foreground, facing slightly downward and to the right. It has a robust, barrel-shaped body covered in coarse fur. The head is broad with small, rounded ears visible. The nose area appears dark and blunt. Short, powerful limbs are partially visible supporting its low-slung body. The background consists of a large, light-colored rock or log and dry ground.
